caption: The drawing depicts a long, formal dress rendered in soft shades of muted green, with a slightly shiny texture that suggests a satin or silk material. The dress features a high waist, puffed short sleeves, a fitted bodice with a row of small buttons down the front, and a wide, pointed collar in a light cream color. There are wide cuffs made of white lace extending from beneath the green sleeves. The skirt is full and floor-length with ample draping and a train, and a panel of brownish-beige lining or under-skirt is visible along the inside of the dress's left opening. The overall composition centers the dress on a neutral, beige background with no additional objects or setting, allowing the style and details of the garment to be the focus. The signature "D.G. Campbell" appears beneath the dress.
title: Gown
